newsitem.title: USA: Frank Sinatra released from hospital.
newsitem.headline: Frank Sinatra released from hospital.

text.p: Singer Frank Sinatra, who spent the night in Cedars-Sinai medical centre, was released from the hospital on Tuesday morning, his publicist said.

Susan Reynolds declined to say why Sinatra, 81, was admitted to the Beverly Hills facility, saying the famed crooner and movie actor requested no further details be released. Asked how the star was feeling, Reynolds declined to say, adding: "There can be no speculation."
"He is at home. His wife (Barbara) accompanied him from the hospital," she said.

It was Sinatra's second stay in the hospital in the last two months. He was admitted in November suffering from a pinched nerve and ended up staying for eight days after developing pneumonia and reportedly suffering a mild heart attack.
In an interview last month his daughter Nancy Sinatra said that when asked what he wanted for Christmas the singer replied, another Christmas.
